detail.longDescription: There's a particular kind of lost afternoon where you open the phone for one thing and surface forty minutes later with nothing to show for it. Treating attention as a resource you allocate on purpose, instead of something that just leaks out, changed how I set up my own days. The full breakdown lives at https:// vibrationofawesome.com/blog/bo om/posts/attention-as-a-resource-you-can-allocate-on-purpose # attention # productivity # AItools You are probably carrying more than you realize.
